content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-012 Privileged or HostPath Pod Misconfiguration) AND BIOC(CDR-012 Container Executes Downloaded Sample) — fuses the posture misconfiguration with the in-container download-and-execute into one posture-plus-runtime container-malware incident.
rules.name: Container Malware Delivery — Misconfiguration Plus WildFire Sample Execution
